contract.title: Draft the October release notes
contract.objective: Write release notes for everything merged to main since the v0.42 tag.
contract.context: Notes are written for users, not contributors. Group by feature area and leave out internal refactors.
deliverables: A list of pull requests that had no user-visible change and were left out
acceptanceCriteria: Every user-visible pull request merged since v0.42 is mentioned once
Each entry links its pull request
No entry describes behavior that did not ship
